cards.card_text: Then the apostles tell the Council that the God of their fathers raised up Jesus, "whom you had killed by hanging Him on a tree."
cards.verse_text: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you had killed by hanging Him on a tree.

cards.card_text: Peter says, "We are witnesses of all that He did, both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem." Then comes the hard part: they put Him to death by hanging Him on a tree.
